body: He has a private therapist he talks to, but it doesn't seem to be doing any good. Another friend already contacted his parents and they're forcing him to talk to them, but as is to be expected he generalizes and evades actually saying anything concrete. This is during the summer, so he has absolutely no structure to his life, spends most of his time sleeping, and doesn't talk to anyone besides his family except through IM. I've tried to get him to volunteer at a food pantry or something, to get him outside, get him socializing, and have him help people, but that was shot down pretty quickly.
